# Report misses with the same care as wins

The recap earns its audience by treating lapsed opportunities as first-class data. The
weeks that listed approved-but-never-engaged threads with their lapse reasons produced
real capacity decisions; the weeks that only celebrated published replies produced
nodding. Keep the misses section as rigorous as the outcomes section, and resist the
urge to trim it when the week looks bad.
